title: Your Model Is Unfair, Are You Even Aware? Inverse Relationship Between Comprehension and Trust in Explainability Visualizations of Biased ML Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI fairness and bias perception, which are core pillars of AI ethics. It evaluates how explainability visualizations impact a user's ability to detect unfair (biased) behavior in machine learning models and how this affects their trust in the system.
